title: Reproduction archive for a well-posed Dirichlet-to-Neumann air-gap operator for magnetic equivalent circuits (Paper I)
description:
Complete reproduction archive for the paper A Well-Posed Dirichlet-to-Neumann Air-Gap Operator for Magnetic Equivalent Circuits: Trace Conformity, and Validation on a 15-Slot/14-Pole PMSM.

Contains the MATLAB chain for the 750 W permanent-magnet machine, the execution transcripts from which every published value originates, the ANSYS Maxwell 2D exports used as the reference, the manuscript source with its 15 figures, and delivery notes for each verification block.

Each script prints its own guard, a check that would contradict its result if the result were wrong. The README gives a two-minute test that reproduces one published quantity.

An independent audit found 91 % of the values published at three or more significant digits to be present in the archived transcripts within rounding; the remainder are declared inputs or arithmetic carried out in the text.

A small set of transcripts produced on an induction-machine annulus is included because the closed-form divergence proved in the paper is observable only in the thin-annulus regime.
notes: Reproduction archive for a manuscript submitted for publication. The companion paper on the doubly slotted annulus operator is deposited separately; the two archives are independent.
